description: How procurement is approved and checked at FoLT (ADR-008).

fields.description: A purchase order whose total (in company currency) is above this is approved by the Finance Manager and then the Executive Director. At or below it, the Finance Manager's approval is enough. Zero sends every order to the Finance Manager only.
fields.label: Executive Director approves orders above
Procurement committee
fields.description: The committee that evaluates a competitive bid is drawn at random by the system when the evaluation is sent to it, from the users holding the Procurement Committee role. The officer who requested the quotations is never drawn.
How many members the system draws for each committee. At least one of them is always from the Programs Department below.
fields.label: Members per committee
Programs Department
fields.description: A user counts as a Programs Department representative when their active Employee record is in this department or one under it.
A supplier invoice's unit price, or its tax share of the net, may differ from the purchase order's by up to this before the match flags it.
fields.label: Price tolerance

fields.description: How many days ahead the daily reminders warn of an RFQ deadline, a delivery or an invoice falling due. Overdue ones are reminded the day after, and then weekly.
fields.label: Remind this many days ahead

name: FoLT Procurement Settings
